info.name: Prime & Ember Steakhouse
info.tagline: USDA Prime Steaks, Hardwood Charbroil, and Fresh Seafood
info.address: 100 Grand Avenue, Financial Center, Chicago, IL 60611
info.hours: Monday–Thursday: 4:30 PM – 10:00 PM | Friday–Saturday: 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM | Sunday: 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM
info.payment: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Diner's Club, Apple Pay, Google Pay (Strictly cashless establishment).
info.reservations: Table reservations strongly advised via SevenRooms or telephone. A $25/person fee applies for cancellations within 24 hours.
info.takeout: In-house curated pickup available for select steak and wine packages. No third-party delivery apps accepted.
info.parking: Complimentary premier valet parking available at the porte-cochère during all operational hours.
info.dress: Elegant business casual to formal attire strictly enforced. Collared shirts required for gentlemen; no athletic attire, flip-flops, or baseball caps.
info.alcohol: Extensive 500+ bottle sommelier-curated cellar. 21+ photo ID strictly verified. Corkage fee is $45 per 750ml bottle (maximum 2 bottles).
